title: Release 0.11.3: batch callback signing, auth forwarding, personalization method fix, and worker teardown hardening
body:
## Summary

`v0.11.2` is tagged at `3e06dfe` and `package.json` still reads `0.11.2`, so this is a bump-then-tag release. Five commits have landed on `main` since:

| Commit | Issues / PRs | What it fixes / adds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `7a74fd2` | #262, #264 | `_client` retains caller's `authMethod` when Basic auth is requested |
| `a9cb0cb` | #812, #265 | Signs batch callback URLs with HMAC-SHA256 to authenticate callbacks from Liferay |
| `ce8bfb4` | #812, #266 | Redacts callback signatures from batch submission paths and request trace logs |
| `233583e` | #263, #268 | Fixes `getPersonalizationExperiencesPage` method delegation to `getSiteSitePagesExperiencesPage` |
| `ebf7db4` | #267, #269 | Gracefully closes SQLite database and clears statement cache before persistence worker teardown |

## Resolution analysis: why 0.11.3 and not 0.12.0

All five changes are bug fixes, internal hardening, or non-breaking backward-compatible enhancements.
- **#262**: Fixes credential forwarding so Basic authentication works as intended; OAuth connections are unaffected.
- **#812 (#265/#266)**: Signs callback URLs using an HMAC token. If no secret is configured, an ephemeral secret is generated per-process so unconfigured deployments fail closed without manual intervention. Request traces mask the credential.
- **#263**: Corrects a method delegation typo (`getSiteSitePagesExperiencesPage`) on `ExtractionFacade` that previously threw `TypeError`. Backward-compatible aliases are preserved, and a build-time contract test prevents future delegation drift.
- **#267**: Closes SQLite cleanly before worker thread termination, resolving intermittent `SIGABRT` during parallel vitest runs.

The precedent is settled: this repository reserves the minor bump for breaking changes (#221 for 0.9.0, #243 for 0.10.0, #252 for 0.11.0).

## Implementation plan

1. Branch `chore/release-0.11.3`; bump `package.json` to `0.11.3`. Nothing else encodes the version.
2. Gates: `yarn test`, `yarn lint`, `yarn validate`.
3. Open the bump PR closing this issue, merge into `main`.
4. Tag `v0.11.3` on `main`, push the tag, and create the GitHub release.

No registry publish; consumers pin by git tag.

## Not in this release

**#3** - the PIM adapter, still blocked on a `headless-pim` spec that exists nowhere. It is the only open issue in the tracker.
